sections.label: SPECIALTY CONDITION
sections.html: Psionics · Self. Whenever you play a Psionics Action or Reaction, you may voluntarily gain 1 Strain to gain 1 free Surge for that card. Use the Strain value after gaining the point to determine the costs and penalties affecting the current card.

sections.label: 5–6 STRAIN
sections.html: −1 Composure, and Psionics Actions and Reactions require 1 additional burned die.

sections.label: AT 6 STRAIN
sections.html: You cannot voluntarily gain more Strain. You can still use Psionics normally, but cannot buy another Surge through Strain. If a hostile effect would force Strain beyond 6, remain at 6 and suffer 1 Psychic Breach Damage for each excess point.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: During your Turn, before using a Psionics Action, you may burn 2 Action dice to remove 2 Strain. This prevents Psionics Actions for the rest of that Turn; other legal Actions and eligible Psionics Reactions remain available. Recovery clears Strain. Ordinary Condition removal does not.
